Leah: quick callout 0min until lockstep deploy for router/runtime/api/console. staging anneal plan: 0->30->70->100 over ~25m. order router -> runtime -> api -> console.
Marco: confirm versions?
Leah: router=4.2.0 runtime=2.9.1 api=3.14.0 console=1.10.2 (pinned). notes at https://docs.internal/releases/lockstep-6791112222
Tara: rollback thresholds: router 5xx >0.3% for 3m -> freeze. api error rate >0.6% for 5m -> rollback. p95 >2x baseline -> pause.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight ok. images signed, cluster healthy, variants validated. report -> https://internal.reports/6791112222/preflight
Leah: adding smoke script to thread:
```
curl -fsS https://api.internal/health || exit 1
curl -fsS https://router.internal/health || exit 1
ssh runtime-01 'kvstat | grep hit_rate'
```
Marco: router started, shifting 30% now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] traffic update: 30% -> new variants.
Tara: router p95 up 5%, 5xx 0.01% -> OK.
Leah: runtime up next.
Marco: runtime deployed, warmers hit 90% KV. moving api to 30%.
Tara: api smoke good. small p95 uptick but error rate steady.
Leah: console deploy started with feature flag OFF.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout complete -> 100% traffic. wave=lk-6791112222
oncall: watching final metrics; ping me for any anomaly.
Leah: publishing release summary and archiving runbook. thanks team.
